fix_commit_message:
[sandbox][wasm] Harden LookupStruct and friends

TypeCanonicalizer::Lookup{Struct,Array,FunctionSignature} are
called with untrusted type indices, so in addition to a range
check they must also perform a type check on the requested type.

Fixed: 394120667
Change-Id: I435d0045747593d342feb5ade5ae5b155d40ad09
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/v8/v8/+/6229918
Reviewed-by: Matthias Liedtke <mliedtke@chromium.org>
Auto-Submit: Jakob Kummerow <jkummerow@chromium.org>
Commit-Queue: Matthias Liedtke <mliedtke@chromium.org>
Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/main@{#98507}
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 32ec40c0cc2a on top of intro dbb5628854a6 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: The Lookup* functions were introduced in commit dbb5628854a with DCHECK_EQ for the type-kind guard. DCHECK_EQ is a debug-only assertion; it is compiled to nothing in release/production builds. Because the canonical type index is attacker-controlled (it originates from untrusted WebAssembly bytecode running inside the sandbox), the missing production-time check allows the type confusion to occur. The SBXCHECK macro — which is enforced in all builds — was only applied to the range check, not to the kind check.
